notes.title: Small Bug Patch (12/25/2023)
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes

Fixed a bug causing the entire game to break if a player tried to load a non-existent save file.
Fixed a slight discoloration issue with the player when playing the idle animation.


Changes

Swapped the new game button's postion with the load save file button's positions.

notes.title: Music Patch (6 / 26/ 2023)
notes.notes:
Hello all! I was replaying through the game and came to the ultimate conclusion that some of the music just didn't quite capture the experience I wanted it to. So I went through and redid everything I deemed necessary to redo!

There was also a few bug fixes and some quality of life changes, I hope you enjoy!

notes.title: April 10th Patch, 2023
notes.notes:
This is just a quick bug patch for some more bugs I have noticed, but with a new major inclusion. There is finally a brightness setting!

Changes:

Fixed the location of Hammer’s Badge
Fixed a bug that caused you to not lose a badge during the Scientist’s questline
Fixed an issue that caused the player to be able to jump onto a non-existent ledge
Fixed layering issues
Fixed the Thoughts poems
Fixed an issue that caused sound settings to not load properly on startup
Fixed an issue that caused some of The Collector’s attacks to not be destroyed on boss death
Fixed an issue that caused the incorrect music to play in most of the levels
Fixed an issue that caused the player to not lose the moon badge on completion of Shroomy’s questline
Fixed an issue that caused the music on certain levels to restart on player death
Fixed some naming issues for some levels
Fixed an issue that caused some soundtracks to play over eachother
Fixed an issue that caused beam type attacks to not kill the player
Fixed an issue that caused a secret to be unfindable
Fixed an issue that caused the player to lose out on an item permanently

Redesigned the Collector’s cutscene
Redesigned Wurm’s background
Redesigned the art for The Abyssal Elevator
Remastered The Dreamer Awakened Ending
Lowered Najis’ health by 10

Added a brightness setting

notes.title: Major Balance Update
notes.notes:
I've been listening to the players as I've made this balance update, and I have addressed a few of the major issues. I hope this helps!

Lighting Changes:

Made the rocks brighter
Made the spikes brighter
Made some walls brighter
Made the player's lantern light about 6X as bright as before (Same reach)


Balance Changes:

Made some attack hitboxes more forgiving
Rebalanced Heila’s Dream
Rebalanced The Hunter
Rebalanced The Harbinger
Rebalanced Uhr


Minor Changes:

The player now starts off with the dash ability
Changed the locations of a few items
Altered Uhr's graphics
Altered some of the inventory graphics
Altered The Hunter's sword attack graphics
Altered the bone attack graphics
Added a time played stats tracker on the load game page for your save files
Added a NG+ stats tracker on the load game page for your save files


Bug Fixes:

Fixed some layering issues
Fixed an issue that allowed the player to get unlimited extra damage
Fixed an issue to cause The Hunter's attacks to not always work correctly
Fixed an issue causing The Collector to play an incorrect audio on death
Fixed an issue causing The Harbinger to play an incorrect audio on death
Fixed an issue causing Wurm to play an incorrect audio on death
Fixed some graphical errors with Wurm
Fixed some collision errors with Wurm
Fixed an issue that caused enemy attacks to not disappear on their death
Fixed an issue that caused Crowlites and Crows to not die on boss death
Fixed an issue that caused the player to be able to use both the tentacle and tear attack at once
Fixed an issue that caused the player’s tear attack to sometimes shoot from their feet


This update also comes with a new game plus feature! After the credits roll on the completion of a run it will send you back to Mondreich with all of your stats and items saved, the only difference now is every boss is respawned and has 1.5X the health as before. For every new new game plus you go through the bossed will get another 0.5X their original health!

notes.title: Feb. 18th Patch
notes.notes:
Hello, I've been working to address some issues that the players have brought to my attention for the past few days, I hope this patch fixes the issues that people were having!

-Added more tutorial stuff
-Changed the location where you get the dash ability
-Added a small window of time where bosses will not attack you when you enter the arena
-Minor bug fixes
